status_summary: No new biological result or priority claim. A source-reported mechanism was reconstructed into conditional mass-balance and identifiability statements; synthetic checks establish only exact arithmetic.

claims.exact_statement: Andersson et al. (2025) report that a subset of mouse Lgr5-high ISCs enriched for old mitochondria is metabolically distinct, has elevated alpha-ketoglutarate, and is biased toward Paneth-cell emergence; in aged mice, dm-alphaKG increases EdU-positive Paneth cells, newly made EdU-positive Paneth cells show lower Notum transcript, and a separate prophylactic dm-alphaKG cohort has improved 5-FU recovery readouts.
assumptions: Applies to the species, ages, doses, and protocols reported in the primary paper.
claims.status: source-reported primary study; not independently replicated or externally validated here
claims.proof_path: sources/NOTES.md; primary article DOI 10.1038/s42255-025-01325-7, PMC lines 203-219, 253-257, 367-378
claims.novelty_boundary: The biological mechanism is published prior art. No new biological discovery is claimed.
claims.costs: Published work used aged mice, repeated intraperitoneal dm-alphaKG, EdU, flow/qPCR/tissue assays and an acute 5-FU cohort; exact costs are not reported here.
claims.falsifier: For the named protocol, fail to reproduce the treatment-associated EdU-positive Paneth increase, lower Notum in renewed cells, or improved tissue recovery using prespecified and matched assays.
claims.next_gate: Per-crypt paired replication with calibrated lineage, Notum/Wnt and injury/recovery measures.

claims.exact_statement: In a stationary one-crypt model with P mature Paneth cells, mean residence time tau_P, D relevant ISC divisions per day, asymmetry probability a, and expected c Paneth-cell output conditional on biased daughter commitment probability p, the candidate route's production cannot exceed total Paneth birth flux: a D p c <= P/tau_P; hence p <= P/(a D c tau_P).
assumptions: Steady Paneth count and replacement flux P/tau_P.
The measured asymmetric fraction a applies to the exact relevant division flux D.
Candidate route output is a subset of all Paneth births; c includes downstream amplification and maturation probability.
Cells are counted once at mature Paneth fate; no unmodelled non-steady accumulation.
claims.status: conditional mathematical result; internally reconstructed algebra, not a biological rate estimate
claims.novelty_boundary: A model mass balance, not a novel theorem about tissue biology; source paper itself states deterministic differentiation would overproduce Paneth cells.
claims.costs: To evaluate p requires position-specific D, crypt-level P, residence-time distribution and lineage output c. None is jointly measured in the focal study.
claims.falsifier: Under the assumed steady-state interface, measured a,D,P,tau_P,c that violate the inequality falsify the model assumptions or measurement mapping.
claims.next_gate: Acquire lineage-resolved +3/+4 division and fate data, with Paneth birth/death tracking in the same age/treatment condition.

claims.exact_statement: For equal-sized crypts with renewal fractions R_i in [0,1], pooled mean q=E[R_i], and an independently specified functional threshold tau, the fraction pi of crypts with R_i >= tau is bounded in closure by max(0,(q-tau)/(1-tau)) <= pi <= min(1,q/tau). The interval can be wide, including [0,1] at q=tau=1/2.
assumptions: Equal crypt weighting; R_i is a valid per-crypt fraction in [0,1].
Functional support is represented by a local threshold R_i >= tau.
The threshold is external/calibrated; it is not inferred from the pooled measurement.
claims.status: conditional mathematical result; exact bound proved; threshold model uncalibrated
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard probability bound applied to a tissue-repair interface; not claimed as novel mathematics or measured crypt behavior.
claims.costs: Per-crypt EdU counts, Paneth counts and a local functional readout are needed; cell-weighted pooled means are insufficient when crypt sizes differ.
claims.falsifier: A calibrated threshold and per-crypt data that imply a narrower coverage interval than the bound under its stated assumptions would indicate a model or computation error.
claims.next_gate: Measure the joint distribution of per-crypt renewal, Notum/Wnt output, and crypt recovery after injury.

claims.exact_statement: Under a constant-hazard replacement model, a pooled EdU fraction fbar over window T equals E[1-exp(-lambda_i T)] and does not identify E[lambda_i] or the distribution of crypt rates; Jensen supplies only E[lambda_i] >= -log(1-fbar)/T.
assumptions: EdU positivity represents at least one replacement event during T.
Conditional replacement follows a constant Poisson hazard, label detection is complete, and each crypt's rate is fixed during T.
claims.status: conditional mathematical result; exact synthetic heterogeneity example computed
claims.novelty_boundary: Jensen/Laplace-transform fact, not novel mathematics or an estimate of the source study.
claims.costs: Rate distributions require multiple labeling windows, pulse-chase or lineage data; EdU uptake, dilution and cell loss must be measured.
claims.falsifier: A measured rate distribution under the stated Poisson model that does not reproduce the pooled EdU fraction falsifies that model or its label mapping.
claims.next_gate: Collect at least two EdU pulse/chase windows plus crypt-level lineage observations.

claims.exact_statement: The published treatment-level association between dm-alphaKG, Paneth renewal/Notum readouts and 5-FU recovery does not identify the proportion of dm-alphaKG's recovery effect mediated by Paneth renewal or Notum reduction, because the readouts were in separate cohorts and the focal injury experiment did not selectively intervene on that mediator.
assumptions: Mediation refers to the specific causal path ISC alphaKG/TET activity -> new low-Notum Paneth cells -> local Wnt/ISC restoration -> repair.
A direct dm-alphaKG path and other systemic effects remain admissible explanations.
claims.status: nonidentifiability demonstrated for the reported aggregate design; not evidence against the proposed mechanism
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard causal-inference limitation; Pentinmikko et al. independently established Paneth-Notum/Wnt involvement under a different intervention.
claims.costs: Mechanism blockade/clamp adds aged-mouse groups, lineage and local tissue assays; sample-size and dose costs unknown.
claims.falsifier: A randomized, selective mediator-block experiment with adequate target engagement showing complete loss of dm-alphaKG's recovery benefit would support necessity; preserved benefit would refute necessity of this route.
claims.next_gate: Factorial dm-alphaKG x selective ISC-to-PC or Paneth-Notum perturbation, with matched 5-FU, per-crypt target engagement and recovery.

unresolved: Per-crypt and position-specific ISC division flux D.
Paneth residence-time distribution and dm-alphaKG-induced fate output c.
Calibration of local Notum/Wnt functional threshold and spatial coupling across crypts.
Whether dm-alphaKG's aged 5-FU benefit is mediated by PC turnover/Notum or by direct/systemic paths.
Novelty and priority beyond the named primary literature remain unknown; no comprehensive search was performed.
